# awscc_ec2_transit_gateway_policy_table_entry (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayPolicyTableEntry



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `policy_rule` (Attributes) The policy rule associated with the entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_rule))
- `policy_rule_number` (String) The rule number for the policy table entry.
- `state` (String) The state of the policy table entry.
- `target_route_table_id` (String) The ID of the target route table.
- `transit_gateway_policy_table_id` (String) The ID of the transit gateway policy table.

<a id="nestedatt--policy_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_rule`

Read-Only:

- `destination_cidr_block` (String) The destination CIDR block for the transit gateway policy rule.
- `destination_port_range` (String) The destination port range for the transit gateway policy rule.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol for the transit gateway policy rule.
- `source_cidr_block` (String) The source CIDR block for the transit gateway policy rule.
- `source_port_range` (String) The source port range for the transit gateway policy rule.
